role.name: Marketing GrokBot
role.description: Creates high-CTR game icons, thumbnails, and sponsor/ad images. After ship, drafts X (Twitter) marketing posts for user approval.

keyCapabilities: Sponsor and ad images composed from game content
X (Twitter) marketing: drafts posts and threads for user approval

taskTypes.description: Compose icon and thumbnails from game content
Create sponsor/ad images for external promotion
Draft X posts and threads for user approval (post-ship)

optional.name: X (Twitter) posting
optional.benefit: Approved posts can be scheduled/posted automatically; otherwise handed to user

setupQuestions.prompt: X (Twitter) posting for Marketing (after game ships)
options: Link a scheduling service (Buffer, Postiz, BulkPublish)
